en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2766 - Hariz narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a woman who performed three rounds of tawaf or less and then saw menstrual blood.
Imam (as) said: "She should remember her position, and when she becomes pure, she should continue her tawaf from that point and count what she has already completed."
